projects.name: AGE of Joy (VR Arcade Gallery)
projects.description: A retro arcade gallery recreated in 6DoF VR, standalone on Meta Quest. Walk through themed rooms full of cabinets, take a coin from your wrist, drop it in the slot and play classic arcade games through a built-in libretro MAME core on the cabinet's screen. Cabinets come from the community; bring your own ROMs.

projects.name: Aliens Versus Predator VR
projects.description: Standalone 6DoF OpenXR VR port of the classic Aliens Versus Predator (1999) for Meta Quest. Experience intense survival horror across Marine, Alien, and Predator campaigns with motion controller aiming and wall-climbing.

projects.name: Animal Crossing VR
projects.description: Nintendo's 2002 GameCube life sim Animal Crossing as a standalone first-person VR game on Meta Quest 3, built on the ACGC PC port and the ac-decomp decompilation: walk your town at real scale, swing the net, axe, shovel and fishing rod with your hand, and switch to third person any time. Bring your own USA disc image.

projects.name: AstroQuest (ASTRO BOT Rescue Mission)
projects.description: PlayStation VR masterpiece ASTRO BOT Rescue Mission running natively on Meta Quest 3 via an ARM64 port of shadPS4, featuring 6DoF hand-tracked DualSense gamepad integration, 3D audio, and mic blowing.

projects.name: Beef Raider XR (Tomb Raider 1)
projects.description: Step into the boots of Lara Croft in the legendary 1996 action adventure Tomb Raider, completely rebuilt for standalone 6DoF VR with dual-wield pistols, roomscale climbing, and physical puzzles.

projects.name: CitraVr
projects.description: Official Nintendo 3DS standalone emulator for Meta Quest featuring stereoscopic 3D rendering and customizable virtual screens.

projects.name: Crazy Taxi VR Standalone
projects.description: SEGA's arcade classic Crazy Taxi as a standalone VR game on Meta Quest: stereoscopic 3D, a first-person cockpit view where you grab the wheel with your hands, plus the classic chase camera and a miniature view. Distributed as a patch for your own copy of the Android version; no game files included.

projects.name: Crisis Zone VR
projects.description: Standalone 6DoF VR port of Namco's 1999 arcade light-gun shooter Crisis Zone (World CSZO4 Ver. B) for Meta Quest 3, built on the native namco22 decompilation and DR-89's Time Crisis II VR host: a tracked blue arcade pistol with automatic fire in either hand, grip cover or physical ducking. The APK bundles the game content.

projects.name: CSVR (Counter-Strike 1.6 VR)
projects.description: The legendary tactical FPS Counter-Strike 1.6 in standalone 6DoF VR! Experience de_dust2, office, and classic bot matches with physical two-handed gunplay.

projects.name: Descent 3 VR (Quest port of the open-source Descent 3)
projects.description: Descent 3 as a standalone VR game for Meta Quest, built on the official open-source Descent 3 engine. You sit in a stereo 3D cockpit and fly the ship in full six degrees of freedom on the Touch controllers while looking around freely. Bring your own copy of Descent 3 (GOG, Steam or the original CDs).

projects.name: DolphinXR (Dolphin VR ReduX)
projects.description: GameCube and Wii emulator for VR, a fork of Dolphin with native OpenXR support that runs standalone on Meta Quest. Play games in full 6DoF 3D or on a 2D virtual screen with True Depth, with passthrough mixed reality, foveated rendering, Wiimote pointing with Touch controllers and per-game VR profiles.

projects.name: Doom 3: Quest Edition
projects.description: Full immersive virtual reality port of the original id Tech 4 Doom 3 masterpiece running standalone on Meta Quest.

projects.name: F-Zero X VR (Quest 3 standalone)
projects.description: F-Zero X racing in true stereoscopic 3D, standalone on Meta Quest 3. A native Android/OpenXR port built on the F-Zero X decompilation (via Zorkats' G-Diffuser): 6DoF head tracking, the original ~60 Hz game simulation at a 90 Hz default refresh, a wrist-mounted race HUD, an optional diorama mode and rumble mapped to Touch haptics. Bring your own US ROM.

projects.name: GalaxyQuest (Super Mario Galaxy VR)
projects.description: Native standalone VR port of Super Mario Galaxy for Meta Quest 2 and 3, built on the Petari decompilation. Play in full 3D diorama mode with motion-tracked Star Bit laser aiming or on a giant 120Hz stereoscopic screen.

projects.name: Generals: Zero Hour XR (C&C Generals Zero Hour)
projects.description: Command & Conquer: Generals – Zero Hour as a stereoscopic miniature battlefield on your table, running natively on Meta Quest 3 in mixed reality. Built on the open-source SAGE engine code: campaign and offline AI skirmish, laser-pointer selection and orders, floating build and Commands windows, plus an experimental human-scale Ground View. Bring your own game files.

projects.name: GoldenEye VR (007)
projects.description: Native standalone VR port of GoldenEye 007 for Meta Quest, built from the N64 decompilation. Step into James Bond's shoes with 6DoF motion aiming, watch gadget HUD, working sniper scopes, and online multiplayer.

projects.name: Gothic II VR
projects.description: Experience the classic Gothic II: Night of the Raven in standalone 6DoF VR on Meta Quest. Features physical melee weapon combat, motion-tracked archery, virtual holsters, and physical swimming.

projects.name: Gran Turismo 2 VR
projects.description: Native C++ standalone port of Gran Turismo 2 for Meta Quest. Features full 6DoF stereo cockpit driving, physical steering wheel interactions, dynamic rear-view mirrors, and 120Hz support.

projects.name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas VR
projects.description: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas in standalone 6DoF VR on Meta Quest. Features first-person motion controller gunplay, immersive driving, and full Los Santos freedom.

projects.name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City VR
projects.description: Experience Grand Theft Auto: Vice City in full standalone 6DoF VR on Meta Quest. Features motion-tracked weapon aiming, physical steering wheel vehicle driving, articulated ragdolls, and Vulkan stereo rendering.

projects.name: Halo CE Quest VR
projects.description: Native standalone OpenXR VR port of Halo: Combat Evolved for Meta Quest. Experience the legendary campaign and multiplayer with 6DoF motion controls, two-handed weapon handling, and full-body IK. v1.0.31 adds online co-op and PvP through the server browser, LAN and Direct Link invites, plus new VR movement options.

projects.name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone VR
projects.game: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
projects.description: Experience the classic 2001 Harry Potter in standalone 6DoF VR on Meta Quest. Features motion-tracked wand spellcasting, offline voice recognition, broomstick flying, and Hogwarts exploration.

projects.name: Homeworld: Unbound
projects.description: Homeworld (1999) in room-scale VR, running natively on Meta Quest 3: the battle is drawn in tracked stereo around you and you command the fleet by pointing at it. OpenXR port of Gardens of Kadesh (from Relic's 2003 source release). The free 1.05 demo is built in; bring your own data for the full 16-mission campaign.

projects.name: Iron Lung VR
projects.description: Standalone 6DoF VR recreation of David Szymanski's claustrophobic dread submarine horror Iron Lung for Meta Quest. Blindly navigate an alien blood ocean, coordinate points, and operate physical switches and cameras.

projects.name: Lambda1VR (Half-Life 1)
projects.description: Complete native 6DoF VR port of legendary Half-Life 1 with two-handed weapon handling, headlamp flashlight, and full campaign progression.

projects.name: Magic Carpet VR (Magic Carpet 1, Hidden Worlds & 2)
projects.description: Bullfrog's flying-carpet trilogy (Magic Carpet, Hidden Worlds and Magic Carpet 2) running natively in true stereo on Meta Quest, on a new engine based on an open-source reimplementation. Fully 6DoF, spells bound to each controller for dual casting, around 120 fps on Quest 3. Bring your own GOG copies.

projects.name: Majora's Mask VR (2Ship2Harkinian VR)
projects.description: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask in full-motion first-person VR, standalone on Meta Quest 3 at a 90 fps default cap. Built on the 2Ship2Harkinian native port: physical sword, shield and bow, masks you put on your face, hand-over-hand climbing, item wheel, and Deku, Goron and Zora forms with their own gestures. Bring your own US ROM.

projects.name: Metal Gear Solid VR Standalone
projects.description: Konami's 1998 PlayStation classic Metal Gear Solid as a standalone VR game on Meta Quest: switch between Virtual Reality, Mixed Reality and Cabin modes, jump into first person, and use the radio, weapons and items from the Touch controllers. Supports six languages. Bring both discs of your own copy; no game files included.

projects.name: Need for Speed: Underground 2 VR
projects.description: EA's 2004 open-world street racer Need for Speed: Underground 2 running natively on Meta Quest 3 through a static recompilation of the original Xbox release, with a full cockpit for every stock car, motion steering, mirrors and in-game VR settings. Experimental development build; import your own Xbox USA disc on the headset.

projects.name: Need for Speed: Underground VR
projects.description: EA's 2003 street racer Need for Speed: Underground running natively on Meta Quest 3 through a static recompilation of the original Xbox release, with a fitted cockpit, motion steering on a virtual wheel, working mirrors and dashboard instruments. First public preview; import your own Xbox USA disc on the headset.

projects.name: No One Lives ForeVR
projects.description: Standalone 6DoF OpenXR VR port of The Operative: No One Lives Forever (2000) on Meta Quest via ReLith, a LithTech 2.x reimplementation. First-person motion-controlled weapons, Cate’s authored hands, and a floating HUD — engine only, you supply the original game files.

projects.name: OpenCMR2 VR (Colin McRae Rally 2.0)
projects.description: Codemasters' classic Colin McRae Rally 2.0 running natively in VR on Meta Quest 3, built on the OpenCMR2 native port of the CMR2 decompilation. Stereo rendering at 120 Hz, Touch controller bindings, and a one-time import of your own PC installation on the headset; no gaming PC needed while you play.

projects.name: OpenMW VR (Morrowind)
projects.description: Bethesda's 2002 RPG The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind running standalone on Meta Quest through OpenMW, the open-source engine reimplementation, in madsbuvi's OpenMW-VR fork (0.51): explore Vvardenfell in first-person VR with tracked hands. Tribunal and Bloodmoon are detected automatically. Bring your own Morrowind game files.

projects.name: OpenXWA VR (Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance)
projects.description: Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance (1999) as a standalone VR game on Meta Quest 3/3S, built on the open-source OpenXWA reimplementation: seated VR cockpits, a grabbable flight stick and throttle, a touch console on your lap, tactical map, radial wingman menu and voice commands. A Windows launcher installs it and copies your own game files.

projects.name: Perfect Dark VR
projects.description: Standalone 6DoF VR source port of Rare's legendary Nintendo 64 shooter Perfect Dark for Meta Quest. Features full motion controller aiming, dual wielding, roomscale tracking, and support for community HD texture packs.

projects.name: Port0r: Cop VR (Virtua Cop)
projects.description: Virtua Cop (1994 arcade, Sega Model 2) in true stereoscopic 3D at real scale, standalone on Meta Quest 3. Built on MAME with Port0r's renderer that redraws every polygon for each eye: hold the cabinet's blue Virtua Gun, shots land on what you aim at in the 3D world, and picked-up weapons appear in your hand.

projects.name: Port0r: House of the Dead VR (The House of the Dead)
projects.description: The House of the Dead (1996 arcade, Sega Model 2) in true stereoscopic 3D at real scale, standalone on Meta Quest 3 at 120 Hz. Built on MAME with Port0r's renderer that redraws every polygon for each eye: the zombies walk right up to you, a 3D gun in your gloved hand, and shots land on what you aim at.

projects.name: Port0r: Rally VR (Sega Rally Championship)
projects.description: Sega Rally Championship (1995 arcade, Sega Model 2A) in true stereoscopic 3D at real scale, standalone on Meta Quest 3. Built on MAME with a new renderer that redraws every polygon for each eye: 60 fps smoothed to 120 Hz, manual gearbox on the grips, haptics from the game's physics and optional HD textures.

projects.name: PPSSPP VR
projects.description: Leading Sony PlayStation Portable emulator ported to standalone VR. Play PSP classics on massive virtual curved screens or true stereoscopic 3D geometry mode.

projects.name: PrimedGun (Metroid Prime VR)
projects.description: Standalone 6DoF VR source injection of Nintendo GameCube classic Metroid Prime running natively on Meta Quest with 1:1 tracked Arm Cannon, immersive helmet visors, and Vulkan multiview.

projects.name: Quake3Quest (Quake III Arena VR)
projects.description: id Software's arena shooter Quake III Arena in full standalone VR, built on ioquake3: fully tracked weapons, a weapon wheel, the single-player campaign and online deathmatch on dedicated VR-only servers. Four maps are included so you can play right away; add your own Quake III Arena files for every map.

projects.name: QuakeQuest (Quake 1 VR)
projects.description: Original gothic dark-fantasy shooter Quake fully reimagined for standalone 6DoF VR with dual-wielding, custom weapon models, and fluid teleport/smooth locomotion.

projects.name: Qualyx (Half-Life: Alyx VR)
projects.description: Native standalone VR port of Valve's Half-Life: Alyx for Meta Quest headsets. Experience City 17, the Citadel, and the Gravity Gloves in roomscale 6DoF with OpenXR and Positional Time Warp.

projects.name: Quest 3 Strikers (Super Mario Strikers MR)
projects.description: Super Mario Strikers (GameCube, 2005) running natively on Meta Quest 3 as a mixed-reality app, compiled from the community decompilation. Play on a miniature 3D pitch on your real table that you can walk around, grab and resize, on a big floating screen, or inside a life-size stadium, with 3D goal celebrations and online 1v1 with room codes.

projects.name: Quest 3: OOT (Ocarina of Time VR, Shipwright-VR)
projects.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time fully playable in first-person VR, standalone on Meta Quest 3. A Quest port of Ship of Harkinian VR with real motion controls: swing the sword, raise the shield, draw the bow with both hands. 72 fps even in Hyrule Field. Bring your own ROM.

projects.name: QuestCarNage (Carmageddon VR)
projects.description: Native standalone OpenXR VR port of the vehicular combat classic Carmageddon for Meta Quest headsets, based on the Dethrace engine reimplementation with 120Hz support.

projects.name: QuestCraft (Minecraft: Java Edition)
projects.description: Minecraft: Java Edition running natively on standalone Meta Quest using Vivecraft and Pojlib, featuring 6DoF motion controls, world generation, and server multiplayer.

projects.name: Rave Racer VR
projects.description: Namco's 1995 arcade racer Rave Racer rebuilt for standalone VR on Meta Quest: stereoscopic 3D with head tracking, an optional split HUD and rear-view mirror, road and powerslide haptics and the original arcade audio, at up to 120 Hz. Free fan port; bring your own arcade ROM files.

projects.name: RazeXR (Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Shadow Warrior)
projects.description: Universal Build Engine VR port bringing Duke Nukem 3D, Blood, Shadow Warrior, Redneck Rampage, and Powerslave/Exhumed into standalone 6DoF virtual reality.

projects.name: Road Rash: Jailbreak VR
projects.description: Native C++ standalone VR port of Road Rash: Jailbreak (PS1) for Meta Quest. Experience high-speed motorcycle vehicular combat, clubs, chains, police chases, and full stereoscopic 6DoF VR.

projects.name: RTCWQuest (Return to Castle Wolfenstein)
projects.description: Full 6DoF VR source port of Return to Castle Wolfenstein by Team Beef featuring dual-wield weapons, gesture interactions, and roomscale immersion.

projects.name: Sclerosis (Amnesia: The Dark Descent VR remake)
projects.description: Standalone VR remake of Frictional Games' Amnesia: The Dark Descent for Meta Quest — a 1:1 recreation of the whole game in Unity using your own original game files. Open doors, pull levers and turn valves with your hands, with optional Safe Mode (no monsters) and PSX Mode.

projects.name: Serious Sam Classic VR (QuestSam)
projects.description: Standalone 6DoF VR source port of Serious Sam Classic: The First Encounter & The Second Encounter for Meta Quest. Features dual wielding, horde combat, roomscale tracking, and 1st/3rd-person diorama views.

projects.name: SM64 Co-Op DX VR Standalone (Super Mario 64 VR, physics-based)
projects.description: Super Mario 64 in first person, standalone on Meta Quest 3 at up to 120 Hz. A native ARM64/OpenXR port of SM64 Co-Op DX with physics-based motion controls: punch with your fists, grab and throw Bob-ombs, climb poles and ledges hand over hand, crouch for real to ground-pound and swing Bowser by the tail. Experimental online co-op with voice chat. Bring your own US ROM.

projects.name: Smash Remix VR
projects.description: Nintendo's 1999 N64 fighter Super Smash Bros. running natively on Meta Quest 3 through a static recompilation (N64Recomp + RT64 + the ssb decomp), with Smash Remix 2.0.1 support: 60 fps battles, an immersive head-tracked view with the camera following your fighter, and online VS for 2 to 4 Quests with a room code. Bring your own USA ROM.

projects.name: SourceVR (Half-Life 2 & Portal VR)
projects.description: Native standalone Valve Source Engine port for Meta Quest. Play Half-Life 2, Episode 1, Episode 2, Lost Coast, Portal, and Portal 2 in full 6DoF VR without PCVR.

projects.name: Star Fox Enhanced (Quest 3 VR build)
projects.description: Native C++/SDL3 port of the SNES Star Fox (built on the UltraStarFox source) with Original and Star Fox EX modes, high frame rates and visual enhancements. Release 0.0.8 includes an experimental OpenXR development build for Meta Quest 3. Bring your own retail ROM.

projects.name: The House of the Dead 2 VR
projects.description: Sega's 1999 light-gun rail shooter The House of the Dead 2 (Dreamcast) in 6DoF VR, standalone on Meta Quest. A Flycast fork runs the original game and rebuilds its 3D scenes around you in stereo, with your controller as the light gun, the agent's own hands and pistol, slide-rack reloading and a second gun for player 2.

projects.name: The Simpsons: Hit & Run VR
projects.description: Full standalone 6DoF VR port of The Simpsons: Hit & Run for Meta Quest. Explore Springfield in roomscale VR with motion-controlled driving and OpenXR Vulkan rendering.

projects.name: Time Crisis II VR
projects.description: Standalone 6DoF VR port of Namco's arcade light-gun rail shooter Time Crisis II (US TSS3 Ver. B), built on the native System 23 decompilation and running on Meta Quest 3 at up to 120 Hz, with a tracked pistol in either hand, grip cover or physical ducking and the arcade's scripted machine-gun pickups.

projects.name: Time Crisis VR
projects.description: Standalone 6DoF VR arcade port of Namco's iconic light-gun rail shooter Time Crisis running at 120 Hz on Meta Quest 3 with 1:1 tracked pistol, physical roomscale ducking, and original arcade sound.

projects.name: TPVR (Zelda: Twilight Princess VR)
projects.description: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess in first-person VR, standalone on Meta Quest 3. A VR mod for Dusklight, the native PC port built on the Twilight Princess decompilation: 6DoF tracking, physical sword swings and shield bashes, right-hand aiming, Midna's view for Wolf Link and an optional third-person mode. Bring your own disc dump.

projects.name: Unreal Gold VR
projects.description: Standalone VR mod that brings the entire Unreal and Return to Na Pali campaigns from Unreal Gold to Meta Quest 2, 3 and Pro, from the creator of UT99 Quest. Free APK on Patreon; bring your own Unreal Gold game files.

projects.name: Unreal Tournament '99 VR (UT99 Quest)
projects.description: Unreal Tournament 1999 running natively in 6DoF VR on Meta Quest. Features true stereo OpenXR rendering, motion controls, online multiplayer via OldUnreal 469, and full bot matches.

projects.name: Victory Heat Rally VR (Quest Standalone)
projects.description: An unofficial mod that runs the arcade racer Victory Heat Rally natively on Meta Quest in full VR, no PC or Link needed while you play. Sit in the cockpit, grab the wheel with your Touch controllers or steer with a thumbstick, at up to 120 Hz with foveated rendering and strong haptics. Built from your own Steam copy.

projects.name: Wave Race 64 VR
projects.description: Nintendo's 1996 jet ski racer Wave Race 64 running natively on Meta Quest 3 through a static recompilation (Wave Race 64: Recompiled + RT64): head-tracked stereo, chase or first-person camera, smooth 60 fps, HD textures, rumble and online Quest-to-Quest 2-player races. Bring your own USA Rev A ROM.

projects.name: Wiicompiled VR PLUS (Mario Kart Wii VR)
projects.description: Mario Kart Wii statically recompiled to native code and running standalone on Meta Quest 3 with OpenXR and Vulkan, no Wii emulator. First-person cockpit with grab-and-turn steering, character body IK, diorama view, VR menus and Retro Rewind support. You build the game on the headset from your own PAL disc image.

projects.name: Wipeout Rewrite VR (Quest port of wipEout Rewrite)
projects.description: The 1995 anti-gravity racer wipEout as a standalone VR game for Meta Quest, built on phoboslab's open-source wipEout Rewrite. Races are rendered in stereo 3D with head tracking, at 90 Hz on Quest 3, with a cockpit view that puts you right in the ship. Bring the game data from your own PS1 copy.

projects.name: XRKart 64 (Mario Kart 64 VR)
projects.description: Mario Kart 64 racing in standalone VR on Meta Quest, built on SpaghettiKart and LibUltraShip. Native per-eye stereo with head tracking in single-player races (first or third person), plus a world-locked Comfort screen for menus. ROM verification and game-data generation happen on the headset; bring your own US ROM.

projects.name: Hexen II VR
projects.description: Dark fantasy boomer shooter Hexen II in standalone VR featuring physical melee weapons, spellcasting, roomscale exploration, and 4 playable RPG character classes.

projects.name: JKXR (Star Wars Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast)
projects.game: Star Wars Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast
projects.description: Wield lightsabers with 1:1 motion tracking and cast Force powers naturally using real-world hand gestures in the classic Jedi Outcast.

projects.name: Prey VR (Prey 2006 Quest Port)
projects.description: Mind-bending FPS with wall-walking gravity and living alien portals running natively under the id Tech 4 engine on Meta Quest.

projects.name: Quake II Quest
projects.description: Classic sci-fi shooter by id Software rebuilt for standalone Quest with HD textures, cross-play multiplayer, and dynamic lighting.

projects.name: QuestZDoom
projects.description: GZDoom source port engine for Meta Quest. Experience Doom 1, Doom 2, Brutal Doom, Heretic, and thousands of community mods in full 6DoF VR.

projects.name: Red Dead Redemption VR
projects.description: ALPHA. Unofficial VR mod of Red Dead Redemption for Android, running standalone on Meta Quest 3/3S: full 6DoF stereo, your own body with arm IK, holsters, manual revolver reload, physical melee and lasso, horseback riding and an in-headset VR menu. Built on your PC from your own Google Play copy (NOT the Netflix version); no game files included.

projects.name: WinlatorXR
projects.description: OpenXR compatibility layer running Windows x86 PC applications and games natively on Meta Quest using Wine and Box86/Box64 translation.
